editorial.blurb: A legendary Chicago deep-dish institution serving buttery, cheese-laden pies with scratch-made tomato sauce and quality ingredients that justify the price.
editorial.insiderTip: Visit during off-peak hours like Saturday afternoon for immediate seating; the front room sells frozen pizzas to take home, and the dining space is in the back.

topDishes.note: Oozing with cheese, fresh tomato sauce, and a slab of sausage; buttery crust with a slight crisp
